beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed culture earns belonging through practical help, rather than demands for allegiance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Success creates another test, because money and reputation can make leaders harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes limited mandates, independent scrutiny, and conditions for ending failed institutions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Equal dignity stays unconditional, while decision-making authority must remain limited and revocable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with A Day in an Outfinitist Circle, then examine Protections Against Success.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the wider argument to judge whether this community could practice its own principles.
